subject: QBR prep — runway consolidation & account playbook alignment
messages:
From: Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — runway ask and account one-pagers

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our leadership has asked us to tighten the upcoming QBR with Redwood; they want a short, account-by-account view of expected milestones and the consolidated forecast to present to the board. High level asks:  

- A one-slide summary per account with current status, risk (green/amber/red), committed next milestone, and expected close date.  
- A consolidated runway table for Q2 with the best / likely / upside numbers by account.  
- Any contract items (SOW, procurement timelines) that could shift the close.

Can you share a consolidated workbook and indicate who on your side will own each account one-pager? Our QBR rehearsal is next Thursday (8 Apr) — would love the materials by EOD Tuesday if possible.

Attachments: none on my end — happy to review a draft.

Best,
Samantha Reynolds
Head of Cloud, Acme Corp
phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway ask and account one-pagers

Thanks Samantha — noted. We'll own the consolidation and hand you a short packet. Preliminary plan:  

1) Marissa to lead account one-pagers for Acme; she'll pull the current SOW milestones and deliverable dates.
2) Karthik will produce the consolidated runway (best / likely / upside) and include sensitivity notes.
3) I'll do a final pass and create an executive summary slide for your board.

I'm attaching a working workbook (QBR_runway_workbook_V2.xlsx) with tabs prefilled for Acme and two other prioritized accounts. Marissa — can you confirm who from your side (AE/SE/CS) we should list as the contact on each one-pager?

Logan Wright
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: QBR_runway_workbook_V2.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway ask and account one-pagers

Quick update from the account side — I've started one-pagers for Acme (Account Owner: Marco Perez, AE: Priya N.), BlueRidge Systems (Owner: Diego Fernandez), and NovaTel (Owner: Neha K.). Notes below:  

Acme Corp (priority):
- Status: Amber — SOW signed but procurement has open questions on data residency.
- Next milestone: Procurement approval (target 14-Apr).
- Risk: Procurement timeline is single point of failure; need legal + security sign-off.
- Attachments to include: Acme_SOW.pdf (signed draft), procurement_questions.pdf (sent yesterday).

BlueRidge Systems:
- Status: Green — legal review in progress, commercial terms agreed.
- Next milestone: PO issuance (expected 22-Apr).

Action items for our side:  
- Marissa: finalize Acme one-pager and include named contacts. (ETA: Mon 5 Apr).
- Karthik: slot Acme into the consolidated runway as likely = $420k, upside = $520k (preliminary).
- Logan: schedule a 30-min align call Wednesday to reconcile numbers.

I attached a ZIP with the one-pager template and a first-draft Acme one-pager. Attachment: AccountOnepagers.zip

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway ask and account one-pagers

Confirmed on numbers and a couple of asks:  

- Consolidated runway tab now includes columns: Account | ARR lift | Best | Likely | Upside | Confidence (H/M/L). For Acme I set Likely = 420000, Upside = 520000, Confidence = M.
- Please review the assumptions tab — most variance comes from procurement timing and final scoping on data residency (adds ~2–4 weeks).

Samantha — can you share the internal procurement cadence (weekly stand / committee dates) so we can time the board ask? Also, if legal needs redlines, loop in Tessa and I'll flag the dependent accounts.

I'll try to get a clean export (sheet + PDF) to you by Monday morning.

Karthik Iyer
Sales Strategy Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway ask and account one-pagers

Team — final checklist and next steps before rehearsal:  

- Deliverables sent: QBR_runway_workbook_V2.xlsx (consolidated numbers + assumptions), AccountOnepagers.zip (one-pager drafts), Acme_SOW.pdf (signed draft). Links above in the Drive folder.
- Marissa: finalize Acme one-pager by EOD today and confirm named contacts.
- Karthik: finalize the likely/upside rows and export PDF for Samantha by 15:00 PT.
- Tessa: please stand by for any legal/SLA escalation requests from Acme; tagging you for awareness.
- Scheduling: Rehearsal call set for Thu 08 Apr 09:30–10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to Samantha and our core team.

Samantha — appreciate the quick turn. If procurement cadence shifts, we can update the runway and highlight the delta on the executive slide.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
